protocol.pipeline: Official SGM corpus (11,034 items) ingested into an isolated local vault with zero LLM calls and zero vector embeddings. Retrieval uses our in-house deterministic Adaptive Self-Information Ranking engine (0-Vector, 0-LLM, no SQLite FTS5, no rank-index RRF) and is independent of the answer model. The official MMRAG SYSTEM/USER templates and the official item text formatters are used verbatim.
protocol.run_selection: Two complete cold answer runs exist for this row. The earlier complete run (published earlier in this PR) scored QS 57.29 / 16.63 (Main/Hard); it is scored and disclosed here, not discarded, and is superseded by the submitted full re-run shown on the board. Both runs used identical retrieval lists (all 1,044 questions, same delivered_k), so the re-run re-samples only the answer model and the judge. The submitted row is one uninterrupted cold answer run per split (Hard 31, Main 1,013); 0 reused answers. Transport-only retries are attempts inside the same run; the first successful response the harness received is scored and every attempt is published. Judge verdicts come from one full instrumented pass (527 calls); every published verdict has one logged judge call.
protocol.retry_policy: Transport-only retries (empty body, 429/503, connection reset/EOF, client timeout) under the harness budget and the configured per-call deadline. A valid answer is never retried, and attempts are never ranked or selected. The scored answer is the first successful response the harness received for each question; every attempt is published with status, latency and server-reported usage, and system tokens/cost sum all attempts. A question that exhausts retries is an answer_error and aborts the run; the split is re-run from scratch, and no zero or relay-recovered answer is scored.
protocol.index_time_note: Index time = cold snapshot warmup 14361.73 ms + local SGM ingest 1.54 s (Main) / 1.56 s (Hard) = 15.90 s = 0.0044 h; the board reports 0.004 h. Zero LLM calls at index time; this is distinct from the answer-generation wall time.
protocol.reproduction_cli: rmem eval --suite atm --tier {hard,1013} --answerer llm --judge off --raw-limit 10 --workers 2 --eval-base-url <operator relay>/v1 --eval-model Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct; the judge pass uses dev/scripts/atm_official_rejudge.py with gpt-5-mini (reasoning minimal) and the pinned official LLM_JUDGE_PROMPT.
protocol.context: Homogeneous 8B baseline: the answer prompt caps retrieval at 10 candidates and uses the engine's adaptive delivery within that cap (actual 1-10, median 10; not a fixed 10-item list). The engine's retrieval is measured independently on the official retrieval-only 64-deep run, so R@10/R@50/R@64 are answer-model-independent.
